step: README.md:L147 cd Sana && ./environment_setup.sh sana (needs conda; docs/installation.md:L4 recommends Anaconda/Miniconda)
why: The linked docs/installation.md names Anaconda/Miniconda as the requirement and the RULES say to install Miniforge for conda-only installs, but setup.sh skipped that prereq.
fix:
curl -fsSL https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/latest/download/Miniforge3-Linux-x86_64.sh -o /tmp/miniforge.sh  # prereq docs/installation.md:L4 "Miniconda"
bash /tmp/miniforge.sh -b -p /opt/conda  # prereq docs/installation.md:L4 "Miniconda"
source /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh  # prereq docs/installation.md:L4 "Miniconda"
cd /work/Sana && ./environment_setup.sh sana  # README.md:L147
